mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO portfolio_profit_loss ( account_no, stock_code, base_date, evaluation_type, start_asset_amount, end_asset_amount, realized_profit_loss, unrealized_profit_loss, return_rate ) VALUES ( #{accountNo}, #{stockCode}, #{baseDate}, #{evaluationType}, #{startAssetAmount}, #{endAssetAmount}, #{realizedProfitLoss}, #{unrealizedProfitLoss}, #{returnRate} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_no, stock_code, base_date, evaluation_type, start_asset_amount, end_asset_amount, realized_profit_loss, unrealized_profit_loss, return_rate, created_at FROM portfolio_profit_loss WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} AND (stock_code IS NULL OR stock_code = #{stockCode}) AND base_date = #{baseDate} AND evaluation_type = #{evaluationType} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, account_no, stock_code, base_date, evaluation_type, start_asset_amount, end_asset_amount, realized_profit_loss, unrealized_profit_loss, return_rate, created_at FROM portfolio_profit_loss WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} ORDER BY base_date DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
